source_text: Triginta tribus diebus manet in sanguine purificationis. Tempus medicinale animae. Non festina ad sancta.
pass_a_gloss: Thirty-three days she-remains in blood of-purification. Time medicinal of-soul. Not hasten to holy-things.
pass_b_english: She remains [[thirty-three days in the blood of purifying >> Bible:Leviticus 12:4]]. A medicinal time for the soul. Do not rush the holy things.
